tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Name of the LMO Manufacturer Name.
Annual Turnover for the last 3 Years
Balance sheet and Profit and Loss Account for the last 3 Years
Authorized Agency Certificate/s from the Principal Manufacturer in original, If Tenderer is an Authorized Agent/Distributor. (As per the Section XI)
Authorized Letter / Agreement from Liquid Medical Oxygen Manufacturers, For Supply of Liquid Medical Oxygen( Supplier or Dealer)
Ownership of at least 4 Liquid Oxygen Transport Tankers of capacity of 13 KL an 20 KL and Above.
Signed Tender Form (As per the Section-IX-Part I)
Self declaration as per Section IX-Part II
List of Refilling LMO to 13 KL and 20KL Containers (As per the Section-XIII).
Service Centre/s in Karnataka & Technical Staff available.
Users Certificate of Refilling LMO to 13 KL Container for the last 3 years( 5 times per year) (As per the Section- XVI).
Quality control Certificate, if the Tenderer is a Manufacturer (As per the Section-XV)
The Location of the Adequate storage Tank/tanks should be present within 250KM Radius from the KHPIMS, Gadag otherwise it is Considered as Non responsive
Tender processing fee in the form of DD favor of Director KHPIMS Gadag. of Rs.3000/- Should be submitted at the time of Original document verification evaluation.

The Capacity of Adequate storage Tank/tanks should be at Least 33KL and these tank/tanks should not be used for bottling Purpose and related documents like PESO License, drug license should be upload. otherwise it is Considered as Non responsive
